{{Top|leg}}
The '''Durosian Sodality''' was an ancient hegemony which was one of many that was swept away during the signing of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] which led to the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
